target.title: Apply consented grouped Claw updates
target.body:
## Summary  > Signing-history note (2026-07-19): signed-history head `14598acdba1e` is a commit-history-only rewrite of previously tested head `11a506c9926c`; both resolve to tree `0348598a062e`. Existing behavior evidence remains source-equivalent. This note does not claim a new runtime execution. - Extends experimental `claws update` from the read-only plan in #102959 to consented mutation across agent config, managed workspace files, packages, MCP declarations, cron jobs, and root provenance. - Requires `--yes` and the exact `--plan-integrity` printed by the latest dry run. - Rebuilds the plan immediately before mutation and rejects changed capabilities, targets, live state, or ownership boundaries. - Applies each owner through compare-and-swap checks, compensates reversible owners in reverse order, and advances root provenance last. - Reports `update_partial` when an external package, config, or Gateway mutation cannot be proven fully compensated.  This remains behind `OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1`.  - RFC: [openclaw/rfcs#27](https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27) - Base/read-only planner: [#102959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102959) - Control UI plugin lifecycle alignment: [#103176](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103176)  ## Lifecycle contract  ```bash openclaw claws update <claw-or-agent> --dry-run --json openclaw claws update <claw-or-agent> \   --yes --plan-integrity <sha256-from-dry-run> --json ```  The executor binds one exact integrity confirmation to the full plan, including separately disclosed capability records. `requiresDistinctConsent` remains available to hosts that present a separate capability dialog or aggregate approval. A changed capability record invalidates consent before any mutation.  - **Workspace:** rooted operations verify expected digest, destination state, and provenance before each write. - **Packages:** exact ClawHub versions use shared installers and lifecycle leases. Referenced removal releases this Claw edge; managed removal uses the canonical removal planner and uninstaller. - **MCP:** validated config writes use compare-and-swap expectations and distinguish exact managed deletion from referenced release. - **Cron:** Gateway operations converge on stable declaration keys and retain explicit partial-state semantics. - **Provenance:** package, MCP, workspace, cron, and root writes preserve the managed/referenced, resource-origin, and independent-owner model.  ## Recovery contract  Package installers, source-config writers, and Gateway scheduler calls do not share one transaction. The initial experimental contract is fail closed, report `update_partial`, preserve uncertain provenance, and require status/Doctor inspection plus a fresh plan. Richer operation-identity reconciliation remains a follow-up.  ## Validation  Current implementation head: `9caf48127adf20d5ad9bc067a6991ab1808b0154`.  - Current-head focused proof passes all 8 update-apply tests, including a no-write regression for changed capability disclosure. - The human capability-preview CLI test passes and proves the displayed plan-integrity token. - The prior reviewed implementation passed 82 focused update, package, workspace, MCP, cron, provenance, and CLI tests. - Changed-file Oxfmt and `git diff --check` pass. - Pre-refresh GitHub CI passed; fresh exact-head CI is running, including production/test types, lint, dependency guards, Node shards, security checks, and `openclaw/ci-gate`.  ## Documentation  Extends `/cli/claws` with exact-plan update consent, mutation ordering, compare-and-swap checks, compensation, and `update_partial` recovery guidance.  ## Stack note  This is a ready stacked PR. Do not merge before #102959 and the earlier Claws ownership/lifecycle slices settle.  ## Independent review refresh (2026-07-19)

Current exact head: `9caf48127adf20d5ad9bc067a6991ab1808b0154`. Restacks the consented update executor on the redacted, integrity-bound PR #102959 plan model. The cron payload builder remains internal until its first production reuse here, and the mutating CLI reuses the shared update-plan output module. Fresh exact-head GitHub CI is authoritative for generated-package and SQLite-backed checks.
